resource: Bytes of one analyser batch (domain 15 delta type 1)
allocation_impact: Measured: the largest fact (a 32-item kill_loot) is 401 bytes (MAX_ANALYSER_FACT_BYTES), so 64 of them would exceed 4,096. The batch builder therefore also stops before 4,096 bytes and leaves the rest for the next sync unit (never dropped for size); the decoder refuses a larger payload before reading it.
boundary_tests: max=4096: the batch builder fills worst-case facts to at most 4,096 bytes and a 4,096-byte batch decodes
max+1=4097: a 4,097-byte payload is refused in both directions
notes: ANALYSERS-0 §6 (at most 4 KiB, measured by ANALYSER-WIRE-1). Registered by OTV2-20261003-analyser-wire1.
